Reentrancy in EtherBank.withdrawBalance() (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier1/contracts/ds_t1_036.sol#18-23):
	External calls:
	- ! (msg.sender.call.value(amountToWithdraw)()) (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier1/contracts/ds_t1_036.sol#21)
	State variables written after the call(s):
	- userBalances[msg.sender] = 0 (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier1/contracts/ds_t1_036.sol#22)
	EtherBank.userBalances (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier1/contracts/ds_t1_036.sol#9) can be used in cross function reentrancies:
	- EtherBank.addToBalance() (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier1/contracts/ds_t1_036.sol#14-16)
	- EtherBank.getBalance(address) (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier1/contracts/ds_t1_036.sol#10-12)
	- EtherBank.withdrawBalance() (dataset/positive/difficulty_stratified/original/tier1/contracts/ds_t1_036.sol#18-23)
